title: Romanization variant ksh→x, learnable through a taught surface even though the phonetic profile itself is blind to the operation
why_real: Lakshmi/Laxmi is one of the most common Indian romanization splits; once the user corrects the formatter on that exact sentence, later mentions of the taught surface come back respelled — the fix works because the surface is now a stored form, not because the phonetic coder understands the ksh/x relationship.

expected.reason: The correction stored 'lakshmi' as a literal form, so both exact and phonetic retrieve it directly on the identical surface — metaphone never has to bridge ksh and x for this case.
